content: Forms is where you prepare forms, share them for filling, and collect completed copies. Each form space keeps the forms and their responses together.

comment.text: Body of the first Forms onboarding tour step, anchored on the Forms item in the left sidebar. Forms here is the section name; a form space is a room in that section.
